blurb: Wet Spot Rentals offers kayak, paddle board, and snorkel gear rentals as well as guided kayak and snorkel tours around Catalina Island. They also provide camping equipment rentals at Little Harbor. The business is family-run and has been operating since 1991.
extraNote: Kayak rental at Little Harbor is noon to noon to coincide with safari bus schedule · Early morning drop-off may be available at additional half-day rate · Landing prohibited on any beach other than Little Harbor · No same day kayak delivery to Little Harbor; requires 24 hour advance booking · No stand up paddle boards at Little Harbor due to lack of inventory · Avalon rental booth · April through September
